answer_1.quote: We categorize the tasks in EIFBENCH into eight primary types. These categories provide a comprehensive framework for systematically evaluating model performance across diverse task settings.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates NLG tasks through multi-instruction, multi-constraint scenarios in plain text, dyadic dialogue, and multi-party dialogue settings, focusing on complex instruction following.

answer_2.quote: Instruction-Level Accuracy (ILA) measures the success rate of individual instructions by averaging compliance across all instructions within a single instance... Constraint-Level Accuracy (CLA) assesses the fulfillment of individual constraints.

answer_3.quote: We employ  as the evaluation model to assess constraint adherence in generated responses in LLM-as-judge manner . Following established practices , the k-th constraint in the j-th instruction of i-th instance is given a binary compliance score S i,j,k ∈ {0, 1}, with 1 signifying full compliance and 0 indicating non-compliance.

answer_4.quote: Subsequently, three certified annotation specialists perform manual review to remove redundant constraints and instructions, revise infeasible tasks, and resolve ambiguous phrasing, ensuring both technical rigor and practical usability.
answer_4.guideline: Manual review focused on removing redundant constraints and instructions, revising infeasible tasks, and resolving ambiguous phrasing.
